steps.name: p-all
steps.eval: (async()=>{const WD=E.Workday;document.querySelector('[data-confirm]').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));while(WD.session()&&WD.session().i<WD.session().tasks.length-1){const t=WD.task();let a=t.amount;for(const c of [50,20,10,5,1])while(a>=c){WD.give(c);a-=c;}WD.confirm();}const t=WD.task();let a=t.amount;for(const c of [50,20,10,5,1])while(a>=c){WD.give(c);a-=c;}document.querySelector('.wk')&&null;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));const h=E.Store.hero();window.__before={gold:h.gold,xp:h.xp,lv:h.level};E.Workshift.close();E.Workshift.start&&0;return WD.session().i;})()

steps.name: p-finish-ui
steps.eval: (async()=>{const WD=E.Workday;const s=WD.session();const el=document.createElement('div');/* reabre a tela com a sessão atual e entrega o último valor pelo botão */ const it={service:'inn',region:E.Settlements.region()};const h=E.Store.hero();const r=WD.confirm();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));const f=WD.finish();return {ok:f.ok,pay:f.pay,xp:f.xp,sxp:f.sxp,acc:f.acc,spec:f.specialty&&f.specialty.name+' '+f.specialty.lv,gold:h.gold-window.__before.gold};})()
